references.note: English table row: 'When you play this card, you can immediately plow up to 2 fields. (This card costs 1 grain until round 3, then 1 grain and 1 food in rounds 4-5.)'
Japanese image list: 'このカードを出したとき、すぐに畑2つまで耕せる。（このカードのコストはラウンド3までは小麦1、ラウンド4か5では小麦1と食料1）'

play.alternative_cost_notes: Round 1-3: 1 grain. Round 4-5: 1 grain + 1 food. Cost varies by round.

effects.notes: Optional: plow up to 2 fields. Cost depends on current round.

post_play.notes: Card does not stay in play area; moves to left neighbor's hand after resolution (per JP source: 'このカードはあなたの前に置かず、左隣のプレイヤーの手札に入れる' - but this text is not explicitly in the A020 snippet. Need verification.)

review.notes: Cost varies by round (1 grain rounds 1-3, 1 grain + 1 food rounds 4-5). Post-play destination unclear from snippets - most similar cards go to left neighbor but not explicitly confirmed for A020. Marked needs_resolution.
